finding: Single-layer (layer 7) weight-orthogonalization ablation left CLMI (mean_pool, full 32-layer probe) completely unchanged at 1.0 for ALL 10 concepts, including the targeted one (aspirin). The residual stream carries redundant multi-layer representations of factual/conceptual knowledge -- a single layer intervention is necessary but not sufficient. This directly validates the honest-scoping concern already flagged in documentation/NOVEL_METHODOLOGY_OGDA.md Section 5 (single-layer intervention risk) and motivates the multi-layer version.
